# Valley Property Services
> Northeast Wisconsin's premier exterior restoration, non-pressure roof cleaning, house soft washing, and permanent architectural LED lighting specialist.

## Business & Entity Overview
- Legal / Brand Name: Valley Property Services
- Alternate Names: Valley Exterior Pros, Valley Exterior Restoration
- Founder & Owner-Operator: James Voss
- Founded: 2020
- Operational Hub: 462 S Good Hope Rd, De Pere, WI 54115
- Phone: (920) 609-7085
- Primary Email: info@valleyexteriorpros.com
- Primary Domain: https://valleyexteriorpros.com
- Licensing & Insurance: Fully commercially insured ($2M General Liability) with a 100% Satisfaction & Zero Structural Damage Guarantee.
- Notable Commercial Clients: Festival Foods, Residence Inn by Marriott, local municipalities and HOAs.

## Core Services & Capabilities
- House Soft Washing: Safe low-pressure (<100 PSI) chemical application using eco-friendly biodegradable surfactants to eliminate mold, mildew, and green algae on vinyl, brick, Hardie board, and stucco.
- Non-Pressure Roof Soft Washing: ARMA-compliant (Asphalt Roofing Manufacturers Association) chemical treatment targeting Gloeocapsa magma (black roof algae) at the root without stripping protective shingle granules or voiding GAF/Owens Corning warranties.
- Concrete & Flatwork Pressure Washing: Hot-water surface restoration (200°F) using rotary surface cleaner attachments to eliminate oil stains, tire marks, and winter freeze-thaw road salt without zebra-striping.
- Paver Patio Restoration: Deep rotary extraction, polymeric joint stabilization sanding, and breathable UV-protective sealing ($3.00/sq ft benchmark).
- Window & Gutter Cleaning: Pure-water streak-free glass detailing and high-angle downspout clearing.
- Permanent Architectural & Holiday LED Lighting: Custom color-matched soffit track lighting systems with cloud/app RGB controls for year-round architectural and holiday use.
- Commercial & Specialty Services: Building facade washing, commercial kitchen hood cleaning, dumpster pad degreasing, graffiti removal, and post-construction cleanup.

## Standard Pricing Guidelines (Starting Estimates)
- Residential Service Call Minimum: $200.00 – $250.00
- House Soft Washing: $295.00 – $650.00+ (based on square footage and stories)
- Roof Soft Washing: $450.00 – $1,200.00+ (based on pitch and organic severity)
- Concrete / Driveway Washing: $150.00 – $450.00 ($0.20 – $0.35 per sq ft)
- Paver Patio Full Restoration: Starting at $500.00 (~$3.00 per sq ft)
- Commercial Pressure Washing / Building Wash: $350.00 – $5,000.00+

## Primary Service Territory
- Brown County: De Pere (54115), Green Bay (54301, 54302, 54303, 54304, 54311, 54313), Allouez, Ashwaubenon, Bellevue, Hobart, Howard, Suamico, Ledgeview, Denmark.
- Outagamie & Calumet Counties: Appleton (54911, 54913, 54914, 54915), Neenah (54956), Menasha (54952), Kaukauna (54130), Kimberly, Little Chute, Greenville, Sherwood.
- Door County & Oshkosh service corridors.
